# U.S. Chamber of Commerce Foundation

> > The U.S. Chamber of Commerce Foundation drives workforce development, education innovation, disaster response, and civic engagement through employer collaboration, talent finance, and skills-based hiring initiatives.

The Foundation leads programs including Talent Pipeline Management (TPM), the Talent Finance Innovation Network, and Commerce Meets Classroom to connect employers with talent while addressing critical gaps in childcare, workforce readiness, and economic opportunity. Through initiatives like Talent Forward summits and disaster response coordination, the Foundation partners with businesses and communities to build resilient, future-ready workforces.

## Key Topics

- Talent Pipeline Management (TPM)
- Talent Finance Innovation Network
- Skills-based hiring
- Workforce development
- Employer collaboration
- Childcare access and economic impact
- Disaster response and recovery
- Education-workforce pipeline
- Talent Forward summits
- Business Leads Fellowship
- Civic literacy and engagement
- Technology-enabled learning
- Gen Z workforce integration
- COVID-19 recovery initiatives
- Rule of law and global governance

## Workforce Development & Talent Pipeline Management

- [Talent Finance Design Workshop](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/workforce/talent-finance-design-workshop-2): Workshop program for designing talent finance products and TFIN network access
- [Navigating Talent Challenges and Building a Stronger Workforce for Tomorrow: A Recap of Talent Forward 2023](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/workforce/navigating-talent-challenges-and-building-a-stronger-workforce-for-tomorrow-a-recap-of-talent-forward-2023): Recap of Talent Forward 2023 summit on workforce development and skills-based hiring
- [Bringing Talent Forward: The Future of Work](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/workforce/bringing-talent-forward-future-work): Talent Forward summit recap on future workforce trends and upskilling strategies
- [South Carolina Student Loan: Employment Outcomes at the Center of Talent Finance](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/workforce/south-carolina-student-loan-employment-outcomes-at-the-center-of-talent-finance): SCSL's employer-repayable loans for students overcoming credit barriers
- [Can Gen Z Solve the Labor Market Squeeze?](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/workforce/can-gen-z-solve-labor-market-squeeze): Gen Z's potential to address labor market skills gap and hiring challenges
- [New Haven Employers Create Opportunity Through Collaboration](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/workforce/new-haven-employers-create-opportunity-through-collaboration): Greater New Haven Chamber uses TPM to build employer talent pipelines
- [TPM Partner Profile: Mark Peters](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/workforce/tpm-partner-profile-mark-peters): Mark Peters applies Talent Pipeline Management at Butterball Farms

## Education & Workforce Readiness

- [New Research Shows States Lose Billions in Annual Economic Opportunity Due to Childcare Gaps](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/education/new-research-shows-states-lose-billions-annual-economic-opportunity-due-childcare-gaps): Untapped Potential research on state economic losses from childcare gaps
- [Black, Latina Child Care Providers Face Heaviest Burden in Struggling Industry, New Report Finds](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/education/black-latina-child-care-providers-face-heaviest-burden-struggling-industry-new-report): Report on COVID-19 impact on Black and Latina child care providers
- [Recent International Assessment Scores Mark Worrying Trend in U.S.' Global Competitiveness](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/education/recent-international-assessment-scores-mark-worrying-trend-in-us-global-competitiveness): PISA assessment shows declining U.S. math scores threaten competitiveness
- [Welcome to Commerce Meets Classroom](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/education/welcome-to-commerce-meets-classroom): Kyle Butler introduces Commerce Meets Classroom K-12 education series
- [How Carley Walker is Advancing Workforce Readiness in Fredericksburg, Virginia](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/education/how-carley-walker-is-advancing-workforce-readiness-in-fredericksburg-virginia): Carley Walker's Business Leads Fellowship work connecting students and employers

## Disaster Response & Recovery

- [Hurricanes Helene and Milton](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/disasters/responding-to-hurricane-helene): Hurricane Helene and Milton disaster response resources and corporate aid tracker
- [Measuring Impact of Investments to Support Communities Amid Escalating Crises Around the Globe](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/disasters/measuring-impact-of-investments-to-support-communities-amid-escalating-crises-around-the-globe): Medtronic Foundation and Walmart on measuring disaster response impact
- [From Devastation to Opportunity: How One Company Sparked Transformation in New Orleans](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/disasters/from-devastation-to-opportunity-how-one-company-sparked-transformation-in-new-orleans): Entergy's 20-year Hurricane Katrina recovery and transformation efforts

## Civic Engagement & Global Initiatives

- [A National Civics Competition For Middle Schoolers? It's A Timely Idea.](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/civics/a-national-civics-competition-for-middle-schoolers-its-a-timely-idea): National Civics Bee competition promotes civic literacy among middle schoolers
- [Justice Across Borders: How the Judicial Fellowship Program Is Building a Global Network of Rule-of-Law Champions](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/emerging-issues/justice-across-borders-how-the-judicial-fellowship-program-is-building-a-global-network-of-rule-of-law-champions): Judicial Fellowship Program unites 25 judges from 18 countries on rule of law
- [Integrating Hindsight, Insight, and Foresight](https://www.uschamberfoundation.org/emerging-issues/integrating-hindsight-insight-and-foresight): Global Threats Initiative on public-private solutions to geopolitical risks

## Optional
